checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Only person is the blonde woman
must.why: Single woman, no one else visible.
Blonde bob and broad smile kept, but face looks somewhat retouched and more polished, and the bob is longer and smoother than the source.

must.item: Beach replaced with professional clothing and plain backdrop
must.why: Navy blazer, white top, light grey background.

must.item: Square head-and-shoulders, natural lighting, no artefacts
must.why: Square, centred, soft lighting. Minor smoothing, but no obvious artefacts.

faults.what: Skin is smoothed and the face is slightly idealised, with a different jaw and cheek shape, so likeness is not exact. The hair is sleeker and longer than in the source.

summary: A clean, square, professional headshot of the woman in a navy blazer on grey, with the man removed; the only issue is a slightly retouched, idealised face and hair compared with the source.
